name.ja: ぷちゅあらいず ガールズ＆パンツァー みほ・沙織・華セット
name.en: Puchuaraiz Girls & Panzer Miho, Saori, Hana Set

description.ja: ぷちゅあらいずにガールズ&パンツァーがパンツァー・フォー！
道具不要で一度に複数のキャラクターを作れ、組み換え遊びで様々なシーン再現が楽しめる、ディフォルメプラモデルシリーズ「ぷちゅあらいず」にガールズ&パンツァーが登場！
description.en: Girls & Panzer is now available in the deformed plastic model series "Puchuaraiz", where you can create multiple characters at once without any tools and enjoy reproducing various scenes by playing with recombination!

description.ja: • メンバー全員分のボディパーツ&着せ替え用のパンツァージャケットが付属！色んな劇中再現が楽しめる！
description.en: • Body parts for all members and panzer jackets for changing clothes are included! You can enjoy various reenactments from the play!

description.ja: • 手足のパーツが豊富に付属！様々なポージングが可能に！
description.en: • A wealth of limb parts are included! Various poses are possible!

description.ja: • テトロンシールで様々な表情を再現！さらにパーツ表面をマット加工にしこだわりの肌の質感を表現！
description.en: • Reproduce various expressions with Tetron Seal! Furthermore, the surfaces of the parts are matte processed to express the particular skin texture!

description.ja: • 汎用顔パーツ付属で、各キャラ表情替えシールが複数種付属！
description.en: • General-purpose face parts are included, and multiple types of Seals with different facial expressions for each character are included!

description.ja: • 台座は大洗女子学園の校章のデザインに！
description.en: • The pedestal is designed with the school emblem of Oarai Girls' High School!
